segments.speaker: Rohan Kapoor
segments.text: Morning all. Let's keep this quick, I have a call at ten.

segments.speaker: Sneha Pillai
segments.text: Morning. Yesterday I was on the payment screen crash, still chasing it.

segments.speaker: Rohan Kapoor
segments.text: Is that the one where the app closes after you tap pay?

segments.speaker: Sneha Pillai
segments.text: Yes, only on older budget phones. I can reproduce it on the test device now.

segments.speaker: Vikram Joshi
segments.text: That's progress, last week nobody could reproduce it at all.

segments.speaker: Sneha Pillai
segments.text: I think the image cache runs out of memory. I should have a fix ready by tomorrow.

segments.speaker: Rohan Kapoor
segments.text: Okay Sneha, so the crash fix lands tomorrow?

segments.speaker: Sneha Pillai
segments.text: Tomorrow, yes, as long as nothing else breaks on the way.

segments.speaker: Rohan Kapoor
segments.text: Vikram, you next.

segments.speaker: Vikram Joshi
segments.text: I finished the search filters. The pull request is up, it needs one more reviewer.

segments.speaker: Aisha Qureshi
segments.text: I can review it after lunch.

segments.speaker: Vikram Joshi
segments.text: Thanks. Today I'm starting on the offline mode spike.

segments.speaker: Rohan Kapoor
segments.text: Aisha?

segments.speaker: Aisha Qureshi
segments.text: I spent yesterday on test data. The staging database is missing half the merchant records.

segments.speaker: Rohan Kapoor
segments.text: Missing how?

segments.speaker: Aisha Qureshi
segments.text: The nightly copy job failed on Saturday and nobody noticed.

segments.speaker: Vikram Joshi
segments.text: That explains why my filters looked empty on staging.

segments.speaker: Aisha Qureshi
segments.text: I've restarted the job, but I'd like some help cleaning the records that did come through.

segments.speaker: Vikram Joshi
segments.text: I can pair with you on the test data this afternoon.

segments.speaker: Aisha Qureshi
segments.text: Great, that helps a lot.

segments.speaker: Rohan Kapoor
segments.text: Now the bigger question. Release 3.2 was supposed to go out this week.

segments.speaker: Sneha Pillai
segments.text: With the crash still open I don't think we should ship.

segments.speaker: Vikram Joshi
segments.text: We could ship and do a hotfix later. Most users are on newer phones.

segments.speaker: Aisha Qureshi
segments.text: Older phones are about a fifth of our merchants though. That's a lot of angry shops.

segments.speaker: Rohan Kapoor
segments.text: I agree with Aisha. We hold release 3.2 until the payment crash fix is verified on the old devices.

segments.speaker: Sneha Pillai
segments.text: Makes sense to me.

segments.speaker: Vikram Joshi
segments.text: Then can we at least skip the full regression suite once the fix is in? It takes six hours.

segments.speaker: Aisha Qureshi
segments.text: I'd rather not. Last time we skipped it the invoice export broke.

segments.speaker: Rohan Kapoor
segments.text: No, we're not skipping regression. Let's drop that idea.

segments.speaker: Vikram Joshi
segments.text: Fair enough, I remember the invoice mess.

segments.speaker: Rohan Kapoor
segments.text: Who's writing the release notes this time?

segments.speaker: Sneha Pillai
segments.text: Not me, I'm buried in the crash.

segments.speaker: Vikram Joshi
segments.text: I did them last time, so ideally somebody else.

segments.speaker: Rohan Kapoor
segments.text: Well, someone needs to update the release notes by Thursday so support can read them before launch.

segments.speaker: Aisha Qureshi
segments.text: Let's sort out who in the channel.

segments.speaker: Rohan Kapoor
segments.text: Also, the design review for the new onboarding is on 9 October, so keep that slot free.

segments.speaker: Vikram Joshi
segments.text: Is that the Friday one?

segments.speaker: Rohan Kapoor
segments.text: Yes, Friday afternoon. It's for the onboarding screens only, nothing to do with the release.

segments.speaker: Sneha Pillai
segments.text: One small thing, my laptop battery is dying again.

segments.speaker: Rohan Kapoor
segments.text: Raise a ticket with IT, they replaced two last month.

segments.speaker: Sneha Pillai
segments.text: Will do.

segments.speaker: Aisha Qureshi
segments.text: Another thing, can we move stand-up later? Ten clashes with the merchant calls.

segments.speaker: Vikram Joshi
segments.text: Quarter past ten would work for me.

segments.speaker: Sneha Pillai
segments.text: Same here.

segments.speaker: Rohan Kapoor
segments.text: Fine. From tomorrow, stand-up starts at 10:15 instead of ten.

segments.speaker: Aisha Qureshi
segments.text: Thank you, that makes my mornings much easier.

segments.speaker: Rohan Kapoor
segments.text: I'll change the calendar invite for stand-up after this call.

segments.speaker: Vikram Joshi
segments.text: Before we go, did anyone hear back about the new test phones?

segments.speaker: Rohan Kapoor
segments.text: Finance approved two, they should arrive next week.

segments.speaker: Aisha Qureshi
segments.text: Only two? We asked for five.

segments.speaker: Rohan Kapoor
segments.text: Two for now. We'll ask again next quarter.

segments.speaker: Sneha Pillai
segments.text: Okay, back to the crash then.

segments.speaker: Rohan Kapoor
segments.text: Thanks everyone, see you at quarter past ten.

decisions.fact: Release 3.2 is held back until the payment crash fix is verified on older devices.

action_items.fact: Sneha delivers the fix for the payment screen crash.
The release notes are updated for support; no owner was agreed.
Vikram pairs with Aisha to clean the staging test data.
Rohan updates the stand-up calendar invite.

distractors.fact: Skipping the full regression suite was suggested and dropped.
9 October is the onboarding design review, not the release notes deadline.
